title: XploreMore event envelope (v1)
description: CloudEvents-style envelope carried as the Pub/Sub message body. Payloads carry pointers (e.g. text_uri), never full article bodies (claim-check pattern).

id.description: Unique per emission. Redeliveries of the same message keep the same id.

subject.description: Entity the event is about (article_id or story key).

idempotency_key.description: sha256(type | subject | content discriminator). Consumers record it in the same transaction as their effect, so duplicate deliveries and re-emissions produce no duplicate effects.
